title: One system across broadcast, browsing and social
slide_intent: Maintain recognizable transitions across formats so different viewing experiences feel connected.
strategic_value: Repeated lateral movement, gradient panels and the green 4 can connect Channel 4 broadcast and social encounters.
demonstration: The film moves from a next/later television panel to a programme carousel and then a portrait social post.
practical_value: Compare which motion and identity cues persist when the layout changes medium.

content_islands.name: Broadcast panel
content_islands.spec: Introduce programme footage beside sliding next and later panels.

content_islands.name: Browsing carousel
content_islands.spec: Show a selected programme card among adjacent cards under the green mark.

content_islands.name: Social frame
content_islands.spec: End with a portrait post that carries programme footage and a smaller signature.

reference_purposes.Application: Broadcast continuity, a browsing interface and an Instagram-style post share visual ingredients.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram says the worlds connect product, marketing, on-screen presentation and social platforms.
